audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly names Hwei's CC ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' — that ability does not exist. Hwei's real kit per enemyKit is P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair. Only E carries the hardCC flag.
audit.why: enemyKit.abilities[E].flags.hardCC confirms Subject: Torment is the CC-paint ability; there is no 'Subject: Fear' anywhere in the kit. This is a fabricated name analogous to the Brand/'Ares of Blaze' calibration example.
audit.corrected: Replaced every occurrence of 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' with 'Subject: Torment (E)' across winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d, report[3].t, report[5].t, report[9].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags it directly: the level chart contradicts the data. full.phases[0..6].side were all 'Skill' (a copy-pasted template identical to the galio matchup's boilerplate) while content.win[0..6] already correctly said 'Hwei' for every stage, and the prose in whys[]/spikes[]/early/mid/late all describes Hwei winning every phase on range and poke.
audit.why: Content layer (whys, spikes, early/mid/late) is well-grounded: Hwei out-ranges Tahm's melee kit with two-cast poke pre-6, keeps zoning with W pool through mid, and out-scales with Spiraling Despair (R) and item-funded burst late. The full layer's Skill/5-6 rows never matched that story.
audit.corrected: Rewrote full.phases[0..6].side/.rating/.why to agree with the already-correct content.win[] (all Hwei), grounded in real cooldowns and ranges from enemyKit.

audit.why: Once the chart is fixed, power spikes already correctly track: Hwei's 2-cast poke wins Level 2, Spiraling Despair (R, 1300 range, 120/100/80s cd) out-zones Abyssal Voyage at 6, and Malignance/Liandry-funded poke at first item is close to unwalkable for a frontline tank.
